scripts.typecheck: next typegen && tsc --noEmit && npm --prefix functions run typecheck
scripts.emulators: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:start --project demo-pioneers-hub
scripts.check:rules: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-pioneers-hub --only auth,firestore,functions "node scripts/seed.mjs && node scripts/check-rules.mjs"
scripts.check:api: npm --prefix functions run build && node scripts/emulators-check-config.mjs && firebase emulators:exec --config .firebase-check.json --project demo-pioneers-hub --only auth,firestore,functions,hosting "node scripts/seed.mjs > /dev/null && node scripts/check-api.mjs"
